# Refund and Cancellation Policy

Effective: 29 October 2026

**7-day refund, if you haven't used the key.** You can ask for a full refund within 7 days of
payment if your licence key has not been activated on any computer. Email contact@clavexis.com with
your order reference (it starts with "CX").

**Before you buy.** There is no free trial, so please check the requirements on the Download page
and the product tour on the website before buying.

**After activation.** ClavexisAI is digital software delivered instantly, so once a key has been
activated we don't refund, except where the Software doesn't work as described and we can't fix it
— tell us and we'll make it right, or refund you.

**Monthly licences.** A monthly licence is paid in advance, one month at a time, and doesn't renew
by itself, so there is nothing to cancel — simply don't buy another month. A month that has been
activated isn't refunded.

**How refunds are paid.** To the original payment method. Refunded licence keys are revoked.

**Licence breaches.** No refund is due for a licence revoked because the licence agreement was
broken (for example, the Software or key was shared or republished).
